samples.summary: Todo checklist for #1045 is fully unchecked even though every listed item is already implemented in the tree (withUndoUnit, requestLayoutRefresh, undoFloorMark, the design-doc update, and the test file all exist), which misleads a reader of the task tracker into thinking the work is still pending.
samples.evidence: All boxes are `- [ ]` (e.g. line 20 `- [ ] TextEditor.withUndoUnit(fn)` ...) yet `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts` already defines `withUndoUnit` (line ~3839), `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts` already has `undoFloorMark` (line ~587), `docs/design/docs/docs-collaboration.md` already documents `withUndoUnit`/the undo floor (lines ~305-390), and `packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/editor-undo-selection.test.ts` already exists.
